# ExtractLinearlyIndependentVectors

Module: **core** · directory: `src/Programs` · binary: `src/Programs/ExtractLinearlyIndependentVectors`

Manual: [ExtractLinearlyIndependentVectors (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/ExtractLinearlyIndependentVectors.md)

```text
ExtractLinearlyIndependentVectors, version 0.01

Usage: ExtractLinearlyIndependentVectors [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -c, --complex : Assume vectors consist of complex numbers
    --rational : use rational numbers instead of double precision floating point numbers
    -b, --basis : name of the file that contains the vector files used to describe the basis
    --column : indicates that the file provided to --basis is column-based rather than a single lien starting with "Basis="
    --check-only : check how many vectors are linearly independent without extracting the basis
    --quiet : only output the minimal amount of information
    --error : bound above which vectors are consider as linearly independent (default value = 1e-10)
    --vector-prefix : prefix to use for each vector of the basis
    --export-overlap : optional file name to export the overlap matrix (in text mode)
    --export-binoverlap : optional file name to export the overlap matrix (in binary mode)
    --export-transformation : optional file name to export the transformation matrix that convert th original basis into the new one
    --export-bintransformation : optional file name to export the transformation matrix that convert th original basis into the new one

tools options:
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
